en.title: Barebow and Traditional Archery Regulations
en.excerpt: Equipment guidelines and scoring standards for Barebow unassisted shooting, string walking, and Traditional/Jemparingan categories.

toc.text: The Unbraced Bow Ring Test (12.2 cm)

en.content:
Barebow Equipment Principles

The Barebow division represents archery in its pure unassisted form. Sights, draw check indicators (clickers), and electronic devices are strictly prohibited. Stabilizers are not allowed, though non-protruding riser weights are permitted.

The Unbraced Bow Ring Test (12.2 cm)

According to World Archery Rule Book 3, an unbraced barebow (including riser weights) must pass completely through a rigid cylindrical ring with an inside diameter of 12.2 cm (±0.5 mm). Judges perform this inspection prior to qualification sessions.

String Walking & Face Walking

Barebow archers are permitted to use string walking (adjusting the finger tab position on the bowstring) and face walking (altering anchor points) to aim at different distances without a mechanical sight.

Traditional & Cultural Formats

Archeris also supports traditional archery divisions, including Horsebow, Longbow, and traditional Indonesian Jemparingan (seated shooting at cylindrical pendulum targets). Custom scoring tables can be configured per category.
